title: Makkah, Madinah schools to adopt winter timings next week
summary: RIYADH — Winter school hours will take effect next week across public schools for boys and girls in the Makkah and Madinah regions, with education authorities announcing revised start times for the school day. The General Directorate of Education in Madinah will begin implementing winter school hours in all public schools for boys and girls next Sunday, Oct. 25. The directorate stated that the morning assembly at boys’ schools will begin at 7:30 am, followed by the first period at 7:45 am. At girls’ schools, the morning assembly will begin at 7:15 am, with the first period starting at 7:30 am.

title: 'Supertyphoon' Rosal accelerates — gale warning up over Luzon, Visayas seas
summary: MANILA: Super Typhoon Rosal accelerated while moving over the Philippine Sea east of Northern Luzon on Wednesday, prompting PAGASA to maintain a gale warning over the northern and eastern seaboards of Luzon and the eastern seaboard of Visayas.
